text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a per-route KPI 'timeline' card for Console. Goal: token-level decomposition (queueing, kernel exec, KV lookup, network, postproc), plus kernel-choice mix, batching rate, p50/p95/p99, throughput, and error rate. Want to catch regressions like the one we saw last week and make tradeoffs visible to product teams.

maya: Nice. Can the card show kernel distribution by tag (native-attn, fused-mha, quantized)? That's been causing noisy perf variance. Also surface sample size so p99 is trustworthy.

dmitry: Quick profiler notes from this morning's canary: kernel-opt-9 rollout -> KV hit-rate on short-prefix routes fell 98% -> 92%. Kernel CPU time is about the same, but KV lookup tail moved +30us due to extra lock contended in the path. Result: route p99 increased ~12%. Flame snippet (truncated):

```
flamegraph: kernel_exec -> kv_lookup_lock -> kv_get -> rd_kv_lookup
approx 30us added in kv_get hotpath for short seqs
```

sam: That's the pattern I suspected. When batching heuristics change (we increased max-batch-window for opt-9), small requests got evicted more often from prefix-KV. We saw more unique prefixes -> lower hit rate -> extra KV latency.

leah: UX idea: small sparkline for p50/p95/p99 across time, and on hover show token waterfall stacked bar (queue | kernel | kv | network | postproc). Also show kernel-choice pie and KV hit-rate trend. Keep the card narrow for route lists, and a larger drilldown with raw samples.

alex: Agree. For instrumentation: we need token-level labels: stage=(queue,kernel,kv,net,post), kernel=enum, kv_hit=true/false, batch_size=N. Then we can build a histogram per stage and aggregate per-route. Trying a PromQL draft for token p99 by stage:

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(route_token_latency_bucket{route=~"chat/.*", stage!=""}[5m])) by (le, route, stage))
```

alex: And a query for kernel mix: rate(route_token_count{route="chat/short", kernel!=""}[5m]) by (kernel) / rate(route_token_count{route="chat/short"}[5m])

maya: Important: sample only N tokens/sec per route to limit cardinality and keep p99 meaningful. Suggest reservoir sampling keyed by (route, kernel, prefix_hash). Also keep a sliding window of last 10k token samples for the drilldown.

dmitry: Adding concrete alerting rules: alert if route_p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.10 AND kv_hit_rate_drop > 0.05 over 5m. Baseline computed as 24h rolling median. We should annotate the alert with rollout id and kernel tag so SREs can triage faster.

sam: We hit that last week — will add a canary annotation to the rollout to make console linkable to commit and diff. Also need a synthetic test: 200 short-prefix requests/sec to staged canary and measure KV hit-rate and p99. If hit-rate < 95% or p99 increases >8% fail the canary.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-17-ker9 -> staging completed :white_check_mark: (id r-2026-03-17-ker9)

leah: For dashboard UX: small card view shows p50/p95/p99 numbers + percent delta vs baseline, small sparkline, and a micro-breakdown on hover. Drilldown page gets the waterfall stacked histogram, kernel mix donut, KV hit-rate heatmap by prefix-length, and raw sampled traces.

alex: Action items: 1) instrument token-level stage and kernel tags (dmitry + infra) 2) implement reservoir sampling per-route (maya) 3) add prom queries and dashboard mock (leah) 4) add canary synthetic test + alert rules (sam) 5) store rollout id in metrics as label for annotations (alex).

dmitry: I'll push the KV lock micro-optim and add metric kv_lock_wait_us per-route. Expect a small fix today.

maya: I'll start the sampling patch. One question — do we want per-prefix granularity stored permanently? cardinality explosion risk. I think hashing to buckets (e.g., 256) is fine and we can expose heatmap by bucket.

sam: Agreed. Bucketed prefix sampling + keep raw samples only for failed canaries.

alex: Cool. I'll put a Console mock in Figma and link to this thread. Let's sync tomorrow after initial metrics land.

leah: Thanks — will draft the mini-card and drilldown mock.

deploy-bot: Canary r-2026-03-17-ker9 promoted to canary group 1 :rocket:

alex: tagging @sre on the alert rule once it's ready. Thanks all.
